name: Slow-and-low credential stuffing
hyp: Few attempts per IP, many IPs, one non-browser user-agent hitting /login.
sql: SELECT ua, COUNT(DISTINCT ip) AS ips, COUNT(*) AS attempts FROM events WHERE etype='login' AND ok=0 AND ua NOT LIKE 'Mozilla%' AND ua NOT LIKE 'NilePayApp%' GROUP BY ua HAVING ips>=30

name: Merchant API keys seen in 2+ countries
hyp: A stolen key is used from a country different from its baseline.
sql: SELECT user, COUNT(DISTINCT country) AS countries, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT country) AS list FROM events WHERE etype='api' AND user LIKE 'merchant_%' GROUP BY user HAVING countries>1

name: Payouts just under the approval limit
hyp: Structuring: repeated payouts at 95-99% of the 10,000 limit.
sql: SELECT user, COUNT(*) AS n, CAST(SUM(amount) AS INTEGER) AS total FROM events WHERE etype='payout' AND amount BETWEEN 9500 AND 9999 GROUP BY user HAVING n>=3

name: Service accounts doing interactive logins
hyp: Service accounts should never log in through web or VPN.
sql: SELECT user, etype, COUNT(*) AS n FROM events WHERE user LIKE 'svc_%' AND etype IN ('login','vpn') GROUP BY user, etype

name: Night-time bulk KYC reads
hyp: Support staff reading 30+ KYC records outside 08:00-18:00 Cairo time.
sql: SELECT user, COUNT(*) AS n FROM events WHERE etype='kyc_read' AND CAST(strftime('%H', ts, 'unixepoch', '+2 hours') AS INTEGER) NOT BETWEEN 8 AND 18 GROUP BY user HAVING n>=30

name: Reset, new device, then payout
hyp: Password reset + unknown device + payout within 30 minutes each.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT r.user AS user, p.amount AS payout FROM events r JOIN events d ON d.user=r.user AND d.etype='new_device' AND d.ts>r.ts AND d.ts-r.ts<1800 JOIN events p ON p.user=r.user AND p.etype='payout' AND p.ts>d.ts AND p.ts-d.ts<1800 WHERE r.etype='password_reset'

name: Webhook change before large refunds
hyp: Merchant changes webhook then 3+ refunds over 1,000 follow within 24h.
sql: SELECT w.user AS user, COUNT(r.ts) AS big_refunds, CAST(SUM(r.amount) AS INTEGER) AS total FROM events w JOIN events r ON r.user=w.user AND r.etype='refund' AND r.amount>=1000 AND r.ts>w.ts AND r.ts-w.ts<86400 WHERE w.etype='webhook_change' GROUP BY w.user, w.ts HAVING big_refunds>=3

name: Rare process on a single host
hyp: Stack counting: executables that appear on exactly one host.
sql: SELECT detail AS exe, COUNT(DISTINCT asset) AS hosts, MIN(asset) AS host FROM events WHERE etype='proc' GROUP BY detail HAVING hosts=1

name: Beaconing from internal hosts
hyp: Regular-interval outbound connections with very low jitter.
sql: SELECT asset AS host, detail AS dst, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(MAX(amount)-MIN(amount),2) AS jitter_s FROM events WHERE etype='conn' GROUP BY asset, detail HAVING n>=20 AND jitter_s<=2
